//Parameters:sandbox: The dev loop runs agents in a per-Run sandbox (sbx) so nobody has to remember a flag. Set to false to run them as children of the Server process. Needs sbx installed with its daemon running; the environment panel names the remedy when it is not. Deliberately here rather than appsettings.Development.json: `aspire run` does not apply the launch profile, so the AppHost is not Development and that file would never load — while the E2E testing builder IS Development and would have loaded it. Measured, not assumed.
